The primary bottleneck identified in AutoBuild's operational processes is the inefficient layout of the central tool and material repository. Because the repository is centralized and located far from various construction areas, workers incur significant travel time to retrieve necessary items. This results in lost productivity due to the time spent commuting back and forth between the repository and different construction zones.

To address this, efficiency improvements could include decentralizing the storage of frequently used tools and materials by placing satellite caches closer to active work areas, or implementing a just-in-time delivery system to bring materials directly to the point of use.
